run_sensor_pos: run sensor_pos to compute position-dependent sensor values like jointpos, framepos, and rangefinder
run_sensor_vel: run sensor_vel to compute velocity-dependent sensor values like jointvel, gyro, and frameangvel
run_sensor_acc: run sensor_acc to compute acceleration-dependent sensor values like accelerometer, force, and contact
run_energy_pos: run energy_pos to compute position-dependent potential energy from gravity and passive springs
run_energy_vel: run energy_vel to compute velocity-dependent kinetic energy from mass matrix and qvel
